notes.title: Quantic Pinball Update
notes.notes:
Quantic Pinball Update is now live ! ːQuanticInvaderː

[h1][b]Additions[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Localization is now available for French, Italian, Spanish, German. Language is set based on your OS language and is English by default
    [*]Alt+F4 is now working
[/list] 

[h1][b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added save if Retry from GameOver screen
[/list] 

[h1][b]BugFixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed All known issues about balls out of table
    [*]Fixed constant loading cursor
[/list] 

[h1][b]Known issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Alt+Tab crash is fixed but another one can still appear with bad luck
[/list] 


Enjoy your Pinball games !
